 Order

This appeal by the appellant/claimant u/S. 173 (1) of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 is arising out of the award dated 06.08.2013 passed by First MACT, Jaura, Distt. Morena (in short "Claims Tribunal") in Claim Case No.64/2011 on account of inadequacy of compensation and seeking enhancement of compensation.
2. The date of accident, negligence and the issue of liability are not in dispute and the findings recorded by the Claims Tribunal in this regard are not in question.

3. As per findings of the Claims Tribunal, in the case of permanent NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-GWL:16810 2 MA-1104-2013 disability of the injured claimant, an amount of compensation to the tune of Rs.1,22,437/- has been awarded by the Claims Tribunal with interest from filing of claim petition till its realization.

sentences.text: 4. Learned counsel for the appellant submits that Claims Tribunal has committed grave error in awarding the amount.
He further submits that Claims Tribunal has awarded the compensation in lower side.
He further submitted that Tribunal has wrongly assessed the contributory negligence.

He further submitted that claimant/Injured was young man and doing work of milk selling, hence, it is prayed that compensation amount be enhanced and just and reasonable amount of compensation may be awarded.
5. On the other hand, learned counsel for the respondent/insurance company contended that the amount awarded by the Claims Tribunal is just and proper and needs no enhancement.
He supported the findings recorded by the Claims Tribunal and prays for dismissal of the appeal.

6. After hearing learned counsel for the parties and perusal of the record as well as looking to the facts and circumstances of the case, more particularly the age of the injured claimant, his earning capacity and the injuries sustained by him in the alleged accident, it would be appropriate to enhance to lump sum amount of Rs.1,75,000/-.
7. Accordingly, present appeal is allowed in part to the extent indicated herein above.
The amount of compensation is enhanced to lump sum amount of Rs.1,75,000/-. in the present appeal.
The appellant is entitled to receive Rs.1,75,000/-. in addition to the amount already awarded by the Claims Tribunal.

The enhanced amount shall carry interest as awarded by the Claims Tribunal from NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-GWL:16810 3 MA-1104-2013 the date of the filing of the claim petition till its realization.
All other findings recorded by the Claims Tribunal shall remain intact.
The present appeal stands disposed of.
